stories.title: NATO jets shoot down drone that entered Lithuanian airspace from Belarus
stories.summary: NATO scrambled Italian Eurofighter Typhoons to shoot down a drone that flew into Lithuanian airspace, likely from Belarus, near the capital Vilnius. It follows NATO chief Rutte's warning that nearby strikes will only strengthen alliance support for Ukraine.

stories.title: Iran's foreign minister Araghchi arrives in Beijing for talks with Wang Yi
stories.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi arrived in Beijing on Wednesday at the head of a delegation and met his Chinese counterpart Wang Yi. The visit comes a week before Chinese President Xi Jinping's expected trip to Washington amid Iran-U.S. tensions.

stories.title: Texas town ordered to disband police after rezident's dirty-water post lead to arrest
stories.summary: Texas regulators ordered Trinidad's police department closed, ruling it failed minimum standards and could not prove a public benefit. The shutdown follows backlash over the arrest of a resident who posted about contaminated water on Facebook.

stories.title: Open-source project releases 7-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot arm
stories.summary: A new open-source design for a 7-DOF humanoid arm called OpenArm has been shared on GitHub and is drawing strong interest. It's a low-cost, accessible hardware project for researchers and hobbyists building humanoid robots.

stories.title: Chinese AI firm Zhipu completes ~$5B financing for next-gen GLM models
stories.summary: Zhipu AI finalized a roughly $5 billion raise combining a ~$2B share placement and ~$3B in convertible bonds, its second major financing in two months. Most of the funds go to next-generation GLM foundation model R&D and compute infrastructure.

stories.title: Tom Hart confirmed to replace 'GP' Lambiase as Verstappen's race engineer
stories.summary: Red Bull confirmed Tom Hart as Max Verstappen's new race engineer, succeeding Gianpiero Lambiase who is heading to McLaren. Hart will take over full-time for the U.S., Sao Paulo and Las Vegas rounds this season.

stories.title: Aston Martin admits to a 'Plan B' as Alonso weighs F1 retirement
stories.summary: Aston Martin says there is a contingency plan if 45-year-old Fernando Alonso decides to retire at the end of the season, though keeping him remains plan A. The team says it won't pressure the two-time champion on his future.

stories.title: Ferrari and Racing Bulls test Pirelli's 2027 tyres at Imola
stories.summary: Ferrari's Hamilton and Leclerc logged more than 60 laps each at Imola testing Pirelli's 2027 prototype tyres, with Racing Bulls on track Wednesday. Imola is also being floated as a possible venue for the season finale if the Middle East round can't be held.

stories.title: Bexley's The Lion adding dog-friendly outdoor patio space
stories.summary: The owners of Bexley's The Lion, the neighborhood's first cocktail bar, are opening an alcohol- and dog-friendly outdoor gathering space. The expansion comes two years after the bar debuted.

stories.title: Ohio Supreme Court declines to reconsider Mackenzie Shirilla appeal
stories.summary: Ohio's Supreme Court declined to reconsider the appeal of Mackenzie Shirilla, convicted in a 2022 crash that killed two people. The move leaves her conviction intact.

stories.title: 2026 Ohio School Report Cards released; Gahanna-Jefferson scores 4 of 5
stories.summary: Ohio released its 2025-26 School Report Cards, showing statewide English language arts proficiency hit a five-year high. Columbus City Schools earned 2.5 stars while Gahanna-Jefferson and several central Ohio suburbs scored higher.

stories.title: Columbus police and fire overtime spending blowing past budget
stories.summary: Columbus police and fire overtime is exceeding budgeted amounts for the year, raising staffing and emergency-response concerns among union leaders. The city cut overtime budgets despite the overrun.
